import pandas as pd

# ============================================================
# EMP-1001 — Jordan Lee : Consolidated Employment Record
# Assembled across all prior steps (employment, org assignment,
# work schedule, compensation, performance plan)
# ============================================================
record = {
    # --- Employment core ---
    "employee_id":     "EMP-1001",
    "employee_name":   "Jordan Lee",
    "position":        "Data Analyst",
    "department":      "Analytics",
    "manager":         "Alex Rivera",
    "start_date":      pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "employment_type": "Full-time",
    "jurisdiction":    "California",
    "effective_date":  pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "end_date":        pd.NaT,
    "status":          "Active",
    # --- Org assignment ---
    "org_unit":        "Analytics",
    "role":            "Data Analyst",
    # --- Work schedule ---
    "work_days":       "Monday-Friday",
    "shift_start":     "09:00",
    "shift_end":       "17:00",
    "hours_per_week":  40.0,
    "time_zone":       "America/Los_Angeles (PT)",
    # --- Compensation ---
    "annual_salary":   85000.00,
    "currency":        "USD",
    "pay_frequency":   "Bi-weekly (26/yr)",
    "per_period_gross":3269.23,
    "health_insurance":True,
    "401k_eligible":   "Yes (after 90 days)",
    "401k_elig_date":  pd.Timestamp("2025-06-30"),
    # --- Performance plan ---
    "perf_plan_id":    "PERF-1001",
    "perf_plan_type":  "Probationary Review",
    "perf_review_date":pd.Timestamp("2025-06-30"),
    "perf_status":     "Scheduled",
}

# ============================================================
# Data lineage status
# ============================================================
lineage = pd.DataFrame([
    {"source_artifact": "Offer Letter",                 "expected_field": "offer_letter_id",     "bound": False, "status": "MISSING"},
    {"source_artifact": "Signed Employment Agreement",  "expected_field": "agreement_id",        "bound": False, "status": "MISSING"},
    {"source_artifact": "Background Check Report",      "expected_field": "background_check_id", "bound": False, "status": "MISSING"},
])

# ---- Display record ----
print("=" * 62)
print(" EMPLOYMENT RECORD SUMMARY  —  EMP-1001 (Jordan Lee)")
print("=" * 62)
for k, v in record.items():
    label = k.replace("_", " ").title()
    if isinstance(v, pd.Timestamp):
        v = v.date()
    print(f"  {label:<20}: {v}")

print("\n" + "=" * 62)
print(" DATA LINEAGE STATUS")
print("=" * 62)
print(lineage.to_string(index=False))

n_bound   = int(lineage["bound"].sum())
n_missing = int((~lineage["bound"]).sum())
print(f"\n  Artifacts required : {len(lineage)}")
print(f"  Bound              : {n_bound}")
print(f"  Missing            : {n_missing}")
print(f"  Lineage verdict    : {'COMPLETE' if n_missing == 0 else 'INCOMPLETE'}")

if n_missing:
    print(f"\n  >> {n_missing} of {len(lineage)} lineage links are UNRESOLVED.")
    print("     Source artifacts not present in the data environment;")
    print("     binding is not possible and no IDs were fabricated.")
```
